[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended resources for meditation include apps like Headspace, Calm, and Insight Timer, as well as books like "The Miracle of Mindfulness" by Thich Nhat Hanh and "Wherever You Go, There You Are" by Jon Kabat-Zinn.
